name: uc-ai-file-analysis
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode
short: Helps your agent send PDFs and images from an Oracle database to AI models.
what: Teaches your coding agent how to send PDFs and images stored in an Oracle database to AI models like Gemini or Claude, using the UC AI framework for PL/SQL. It also covers pulling text out of PDFs and images (OCR).
who: Oracle PL/SQL and Oracle APEX developers. It's no use without an Oracle database and the UC AI framework.
needs: Oracle Database 12.2 or later, and Oracle APEX
The UC AI framework installed in your database (see UC AI's installation docs)
An API key for your AI provider, and a model that accepts files. Provider usage is paid

steps.title: Or copy them in by hand

try.label: Suggested
try.text: Using UC AI, write a PL/SQL block that sends the PDF in my_docs.blob_content where id = 1 to Gemini and asks for a one-paragraph summary.

watch: Big PDFs and high-resolution images use a lot of tokens, which costs money. Check the usage on each result.
Set the file's type (MIME type) correctly, or the AI provider may reject or misread it.
Sending company documents to an outside AI service may raise data protection questions. Check before you use real customer files.
